parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: the removed per-year holiday cache causes BusinessCalendar.holidays to call the holiday source on every is_business_day check, so JsonHolidaySource re-reads and re-parses the JSON file repeatedly during day-by-day loops in roll_forward, add_business_days and business_days_between. Different wording and line ranges (38 vs 37-38) but the same root cause and place.
